comments:
[CTQMVBPR]: 37-38 an n. 40 reports that two dates are given in the [R894SIKE] for his birth: 1172 (given directly and can be inferred from the age given for him at the time of the birth of Chag lo (ID:6412) and 1173. [R894SIKE]: 828 sets his birth in a water female serpent year (1173), three years after the passing of Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856) (in 1170).
Active as a translator, he invited the three Indian paṇḍitas Śrījagatamitrānanda, alias Mitrayogin, Buddhaśrījñāna and Śākyaśrī to Tibet ([2X2E3882]: 253).
